response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong full-stack, distributed systems, and mentoring/teaching credentials, but his career is almost entirely in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, JavaScript, and web/mobile stacks rather than C++. He only has brief C++ exposure (National Instruments, ~6 months, plus a bachelor thesis project) which falls far short of the 8 years of C++ programming required, and there's no evidence of production cloud-compute platform architecture or formal technical leadership managing engineers, making him a poor fit despite his seniority and breadth.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Strong track record of mentoring, teaching workshops, and community leadership (FOSS4G talks, Selenium courses, Refactoring Dojos)
Experience with micro-services, high-throughput low-latency systems, and DevOps/CI infrastructure setup
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments), nowhere near the required 8 years
No evidence of formal technical leadership role managing/mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers
Career focus is primarily TypeScript/Node.js/DLang web platforms, not large-scale cloud compute or hardware architecture

key_factors.factor: C++ experience far below minimum requirement
Lack of production cloud-compute architecture and formal leadership experience
Broad distributed systems and mentoring background transferable to leadership
